variables.name: JWT_SECRET
variables.description: HS256 secret used to sign all Supabase JWTs. Auto-generated. Referenced by rest, realtime, storage via ${{auth.JWT_SECRET}}.

variables.name: ANON_KEY
variables.description: Public client API key — JWT signed by JWT_SECRET with role=anon. Generate at https://supabase.com/docs/guides/self-hosting#api-keys using your JWT_SECRET.

variables.name: SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
variables.description: Server-side key with full DB access — JWT signed by JWT_SECRET with role=service_role. Keep secret. Generate at https://supabase.com/docs/guides/self-hosting#api-keys.

variables.name: DASHBOARD_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password for admin dashboard access. Auto-generated.

variables.name: GOTRUE_SMTP_HOST
variables.description: SMTP server host for sending auth emails. Leave empty to disable email. Example: smtp.gmail.com

variables.name: GOTRUE_SMTP_PORT
variables.description: SMTP server port (587 for TLS, 465 for SSL). Leave empty if SMTP host is empty.

variables.name: GOTRUE_MAILER_AUTOCONFIRM
variables.description: Auto-confirm user emails on signup (dev mode). Set to false in production.

variables.name: GOTRUE_EXTERNAL_EMAIL_ENABLED
variables.description: Enable external email provider support. Set to false to disable email auth.

variables.name: GOTRUE_URI_ALLOW_LIST
variables.description: Comma-separated additional redirect URIs for OAuth. Leave empty to allow only the site URL.
